feedback.summary: Complete manually selected lexical and contextual annotation of the bakery story. Retrospective interpretation is intentional; physical states retain narrated time, quoted content stays attributed, and proposed plans are not promoted to actions.

ambiguities.issue: Birthday time is reported retrospectively with today and a seasonal swallow cue.
ambiguities.decision: today anchors to the current Thursday in Tessa's paraphrase; no absolute date, annual migration schedule, or date-consistency repair is invented.

ambiguities.issue: Repeated it shifts between cake and basket.
ambiguities.decision: Resolve 155 to cake (purpose of asking for basket), 172/196 to basket, 277 to cake and 611 to cake; 611 could narrowly mean the flower but reported bump targets the transported cake.

ambiguities.issue: Repeated mentions of historical repair, telling and purchase are not repeated physical events.
ambiguities.decision: Reuse event IDs through mention_event; distinct outer communication turns keep their own IDs.

ambiguities.issue: Colorful socks and playful decoration descriptions may carry tact or humor.
ambiguities.decision: Annotate explicit evaluations and clear visual metaphor; do not infer sarcasm, insult or hidden disappointment.

ambiguities.issue: A real smile and blowing out the candle do not explicitly report a wish or a named inner emotion.
ambiguities.decision: Keep genuine outward display and candle event; omit an invented wish-making event or measured happiness.

ambiguities.issue: Empty basket still contains tea towel.
ambiguities.decision: Record contents towel, excluding cake/box, rather than absolute emptiness.

ambiguities.issue: Final joint return is a proposal; story ends before tomorrow.
ambiguities.decision: Keep obligation and future commitment, do not assert completed return or Tessa's unstated acceptance.

feature_gaps.reason: Needed for novel swimming/wandering metaphors and candle/twig simile; neither irony nor conventional lexical idiom fits.

The catalog has many specialized material/state fields but no ordinary typed color/size/flavor field; retained legacy name/string values for blue, small and lemon. A future common property schema would improve consistency.
Multiple event memberships and speaker/content overlap need the provisional array; singular fields cannot represent all roles.

prompt_feedback: Specify event identity versus event mention identity, including repeated descriptions across quotation scopes; reuse underlying physical events and allocate distinct actual speech acts.
Keep the newly clarified patients/instruments ID override visible alongside the original feature descriptions, which otherwise prescribe names.
Distinguish actual utterance event scope from its quoted content scope; secondary speech events can share a word anchor without replacing content participants.
Give a scoped-emptiness example such as empty basket with towel still inside, so annotations do not infer universal absence.

Keep the shared leading-component contraction policy visible: this pilot uses pron/I for I'd and I'm, pron/you for You're, pron/it for It's, with full auxiliary expansions; won't and don't remain verbal contractions.
Time expressions need a policy for reported deictic reformulation: today in a present retelling of last spring's conversation need not mean that historical conversation day.
Narrative closure and character change should cite physical evidence and remain interpretations, without turning smile/light imagery into unsupported psychiatric or personality claims.
feedback.coverage_notes: All 854 word occurrences have explicit contextual POS; every inflected/proper-name/contraction lemma was reviewed. Events, pronouns, quotations, conditions, object parts, route choice, decorations, cake integrity, arithmetic and loan commitments were reviewed paragraph by paragraph. Function words receive grammar/operator labels where appropriate; omissions remain unknown, not false. Full dependency trees and all 1,024 dimensions are deliberately not fabricated.

feedback.summary: Complete manual retrospective annotation of the puppet-rehearsal story, with separate people, puppets, fictional characters, old/new props, staged-world events, quoted plans and actual handling.

ambiguities.issue: star’s gone can expand to star is gone (chosen adjectival missing-state reading) or star has gone; neither implies ownership morphology.
theatre denotes the narrow puppet booth initially and broader performance/audience space later; a coarse shared identity is retained without a precise physical extent.
Physical prop mentions fill represented gift roles through explicit enactment bridges; e16/e17 remain distinct from fictional gift e18.
Button is the selected antecedent of It’s not silver; replacement appearance is selected for I don’t want it to look. Whole staging is a plausible latter alternative.
Sagging point and top are one coarse region; exact point identity is not guaranteed.
Performance anxiety is an annotated candidate from bodily cues and context, not explicit fear. No permanent confidence trait is asserted.
Nia voices Moon; its physical manipulator is unknown.
Star from prohibited curtain-cutting has no actual entity witness; it is a hypothetical alternative, not the completed replacement.
Individual knees, inhaled breath and the Moon’s metaphorical way remain lexical/event participants without invented stable entity identities.
Proposed replacement/golden star is linked retrospectively to later physical replacement; its suggested gold appearance is scoped, not a material assertion.

feature_gaps.why: Need correlated physical performer, puppet/prop and represented fictional identity; semantic_world_id alone cannot express the bridge or distinguish voicing from manipulation.
Surface color needs an entity-bound typed value independent of material. Silver/gold here are appearance labels; brass is material.
Actual token-level part→whole links are separate from reference-licensing bridging_relation or lexical part types.
One occurrence participates in multiple predicates; especially staged/physical readings and shared subjects. Preserve correlated memberships.

feature_gaps.meaning: weight and qualitative length comparison
feature_gaps.why: Stored as legacy attributes/quantity comparison cue; exact quantitative dimension+comparison operands need richer typed bundles.

prompt_feedback: Explicitly define a two-world performance example: puppet, performer, character, prop realization, and voice performer are different links; an identified voice performer does not establish physical manipulation.
Require source-relative scope for negative plans and requirements: cannot remain lonely, do not cut, and without dropping are not reports of observed absence.
State whether a repeated script direction points to the same scripted event. This pilot reuses ev18 at its second reading and keeps actual reading acts ev19/ev139 distinct.
Clarify contraction POS and lemma with It’s, There’s and star’s examples. Retain contraction alternatives when is versus has cannot be resolved.
Give an example of explicit light reflection versus light emission; catches light does not make a brass button a lamp.
Avoid treating empty theatre as zero people when the same sentence explicitly leaves friends inside; define the restricted occupancy domain.
Allow local evidence notes for grounded inference without upgrading a likely emotion, cause or broad theme to a certain psychological fact.
Document event-count granularity for state observations and causative phase predicates; IDs identify this annotation’s event analyses, not a universal segmentation.
feedback.coverage_notes: Every one of 841 words has manual POS+lemma. All 44 paragraphs were read in full. Content predicates, entity mentions, quotation scopes, modality, grammar, plans, roles, materials, physical relations, creation/return, causal links, and narrative changes are covered sparsely; unavailable facts are omitted. No causal-prefix filtering or API calls. Nonword tokens are deterministic synthetic records.
not_claimed: literal emotional state of an astronomical moon

feedback.summary: Complete manual retrospective annotation of the greenhouse story, with distinct plants/pots/clips, scoped instructions and counterfactuals, and temporary shade preceding repair.

ambiguities.issue: It snapped could denote the clip or shade/flap incident; the report has an unresolved participant and candidate support events.

Okafor reports earlier slipping and a trip for clips, while the narrated snap occurs after Nia waters. Separate report-content event retains uncertain identity and phase chronology; it may describe this same displacement or an earlier related slip.
First watered tray, nearest exposed tray and final labeled tray are not explicitly identical; separate IDs preserve that uncertainty.
One watering can is a capacity unit rather than an independently introduced can object; no numeric volume is invented.
Before leaving establishes ordering but does not explicitly narrate departure completion; departure remains a projected event.

feature_gaps.meaning: qualitative size, weight, visual strength, texture and manner
feature_gaps.resolution: Use contextual events and legacy attributes where no precise existing typed dimension applies; no new attribute names needed in this story.

feature_gaps.meaning: same underlying dynamic process at goal/in-progress/completed stages
feature_gaps.resolution: Actual repeated mentions reuse event IDs; hypothetical instructions/conditions remain separately scoped. Leak-repair work and completed tap repair retain distinct phase events because exact physical component equivalence is not explicit.

prompt_feedback: Keep the v1 empty-domain example: the empty clay pot explicitly contains pebbles, so universal zero containment would be wrong.
Add examples of event reference with unresolved physical participant (It snapped) and historical reports with unresolved phase chronology.
Contraction can’s in Your can’s ready has noun-leading POS and lemma can; it is not possessive or the modal auxiliary.
Label imperatives must not attribute authorship simply because an owner is named on the label.
feedback.coverage_notes: Every word has explicit contextual POS and normalized lemma. Important content has entities/events/grammar/state features. Sparse annotation, no quota. The source leaves no completed home journey or leaf-selection outcome. No psychic emotion, unsupported ownership transfer, exact duration or complete plant recovery was invented.

feedback.summary: Manual retrospective annotation of the seaside route mistake, correction, shared drawing and anemone observation. Distinguishes physical landmarks, mistaken labels, map representations, imagined plans and the final sketch.

ambiguities.issue: The initially desired pool is nonspecific e69; the actual destination pool is e46. Goal satisfaction does not force identity of a hypothetical witness.
Milo recognizes Captain; later anemone uses the same discourse ID with attributed identification, not biological proof of individual identity since last summer.
Twin Chimneys at the mistaken turn names the bathhouse pair e17; correct landmark is e8. The belief’s intended landmark remains separate from its perceived wrong referent.
Map marks and final sketch entities are distinct from their referents; representation links are recorded explicitly.
Milo’s collective wrong-route report ev143 is the shared episode containing Tessa’s leading ev86 and Milo’s following ev46, not another walk.
No path drawn on map does not prove no physical passage. Shore passage exists but shrinks; the scramble is never performed.
Route-flanking rocks and view-gap rocks have separate IDs because exact overlap is unknown.
Wall offers a basket resting place, but actual basket placement and picnic-cloth deployment are not narrated. No invented placing/unpacking event.
Two is a local clock time with no stated meridiem; timely return is promised but never shown.
Not sounding cross does not prove absence of anger; Tessa’s look is uninterpreted. Grinning and laughing are explicit behaviors, not permanent personality labels.

A mobility aid and temporary healing condition do not license a broader diagnosis or blanket traversal incapacity.
A source can narrate actual custody endpoints while omitting intermediate transfers; record the gap.
A final drawing can combine pictured elements without relocating their real-world referents.

feedback.summary: Festival annotations preserve changes in gate clearance, reachable hanging, author/chooser/tyer roles and the distinct spool/string identities. Figurative rainbow, bossy wind, trying string and seeing moon are separated from physical states.

ambiguities.issue: Return before supper is promised but unobserved. Evening does not establish deadline passed; string in use does not imply spool return or breach.
Rafi is allowed to tie and actually ties rail knot, but Bea ties his moon at his chosen position. No false Rafi attachment or total goal fulfillment is added.
It looks better may refer to moon or overall bunting; reference placeholder retains both.
Unspecified flag handed to girl may be blue star, but explicit identity and attachment actor are absent.
Baker tying paper loaf is not explicitly Duran; no forced identity.
Spool moves from Bea carrying to Rafi holding without narrated handoff; no transfer invented.
Folding tables interpreted as portable table type in coordinated set-out list; source surface could also admit folding activity reading.
Unattributed too-tight joke assigned to Rafi through turn continuity, recorded as candidate speaker interpretation.

prompt_feedback: Separate permission, choosing, tying, and final object position; source can distribute these actions among different participants.
Treat a planned last action separately from an observed action of the same kind when more actions follow.
Preserve borrowed container versus used material identity, and do not infer deadline failure solely from an evening ending.
Accessibility claims should bind the stated person, task and route, without inferring diagnoses or general incapacity.
Methods can recur in distinct teaching acts while the underlying earlier wrapping event remains singular.

feedback.summary: Retrospective annotation of shared baking, a recalled Pepper rescue, disagreement over the last dough portion, recombination and collaborative design, and gift delivery.

ambiguities.issue: Rescue recollections reuse the same past finding and flashlight-holding events. Negation at didn’t find ... because rejects a reason, not the actual rescue.
Living Pepper, shaped cutters, planned biscuit referents, existing biscuit groups and final decorated biscuit are separate. Four dogs is an allocation claim before delivery, not four actual pets.
Mom offered a cake; children wanted to do the thanks themselves and made biscuits. No actual cake is added.
Borrowing and cleaning/drying cutters are explicit, but their return is not narrated. Loan completion is not inferred from a familiar story pattern.
Eight minutes is the stated baking requirement. One minute to spare is the oven-entry margin; exact deadline identity and a clock-stamped actual eight-minute duration are not independently given.
Torn pieces are unequal and recombined. Toby’s claimed best piece cannot confidently be identified with the larger or smaller piece.
Pink ears and a brightened face are observed; specific emotions such as shame, pride or relief are not forced.
Star impression is a shallow mark on the dog biscuit, not a second cut-out. A rabbit biscuit is present on the tray, although its cutting is omitted in the earlier row summary.
Cooling precedes packing, but cooling duration and tray removal action are not narrated. Alvarez receives the tin; no actual feeding of Pepper or consumption of biscuits is asserted.

feature_gaps.meaning: Explicitly explained artifact symbolism
feature_gaps.resolution: Proposed symbolic_reference binds carrier, represented referent, speaker, scope and attribution. This is distinct from shape, living identity, metaphor, and performance enactment.

prompt_feedback: Keep negated causal reasons separate from the factual event being explained.
Gift plans and allocation language need not imply current recipient custody.
A symbol can refer to a physical object without depicting its outline: the star stands for a flashlight.
A recipe duration and scheduling slack use the same units but attach to different event roles.

limits: Checks shape, losslessness, declared types, identity links and provenance. Semantic quality requires the separate phase reviews. Missing features are unknown or unannotated, not false.
